1.

O Lord, what joy it is That the suffering Thou didst endure here Is ended, and that Thou, Who here in weakness wast crucified, Hast accomplished the atonement And now reapest the reward.

2.

Thou, who here wast crowned with thorns, Now bearest the crown of glory, Bestowed on Thee by the Father. Thy praise we already sing, For Thou, our Jesus, only Thou Art worthy of praise and honour.

3.

As Head for us Thou art there, We Thy members are here And are one with Thee. Thy grace, Thy riches, and Thy power, All that Thy love hath promised us, We have in Thee.

4.

Our greatest joy it already is, As we walk here on earth, That Thou hast received Thy joy; And as we now wait, The thought is sweet to us that Thou Hast attained Thy glory.
